sources: Configuration The configuration file atlas.toml contains the following keys. sync_interval sets how often Atlas checks for changes, in seconds. The default is 300 seconds. max_upload_mb limits the size of a single file upload. The default is 250 MB; larger files are skipped with a warning. retry_limit controls how many times a failed transfer is retried. The default is 5 attempts with exponential backoff. cache_dir sets the folder used for the local cache. The default is ~/.atlas/cache. encryption can be set to aes256 or none. When it is set to aes256, files are encrypted on the laptop before upload. bandwidth_limit caps the upload speed in kilobytes per second; 0 means unlimited.

sources: # Evaluating a RAG System ## Retrieval metrics Recall@k is the fraction of questions for which at least one correct passage appears in the top k retrieved results. Recall@5 is the most common version. Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) averages 1 / rank of the first correct passage, so it rewards systems that put the right passage near the top. ## Answer metrics Faithfulness measures whether every claim in an answer is supported by the retrieved passages. It is often scored by a second language model acting as a judge. Answer correctness compares the answer with a reference answer written by a person. ## Refusal cases A good evaluation set includes questions whose answer is not in the documents. For these, the correct response is "I don't know", and the system is scored on how often it refuses
answer: Recall@5 is the most common version [1].

sources: runs semantic search and keyword search together and merges the two result lists. A common merging method is Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), which adds 1 / (k + rank) for each list a passage appears in, usually with k = 60. Hybrid search usually retrieves better passages than either method alone. ## Reranking A reranker is a cross-encoder model that reads the question and a passage together and outputs a relevance score. It is slower than vector search, so it is only applied to the top 20 to 50 candidates, which it reorders so the most relevant passages come first.
